topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the multi-step model of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and oncogenic mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in growth factor receptors and downstream signaling cascades drive growth signal independence and sustained proliferation.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how differentiation blocks prevent cells from maturing and exiting the cell cycle in both hematological malignancies and intestinal carcinoma.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 and Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Telomeres, senescence bypass, and cellular stress surveillance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms of telomere shortening, senescence induction, TERT reactivation, and p53-mediated stress responses that govern replicative lifespan and cell-autonomous growth.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolism via aerobic glycolysis and Krebs cycle mutations to support biosynthetic demands.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascularization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains why growing tumors require an angiogenic switch to supply oxygen and nutrients, and how this balance is regulated.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the multi-step metastatic cascade, clinical detection via liquid biopsies, metastatic inefficiency, and the genomic features of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by summarizing the convergence of cancer hallmarks and providing closing practical information.
